disposition: Retain the existing prospective common/split comparison; no new arm, recipe edit or novelty claim.
primary_question: Does route-specific assignment of permitted factual similarity targets improve the unchanged served native predictor beyond the common-target and native baseline methods?
attribution_limit: A split-common gain can reflect lower target entropy or easier realizability, as well as useful specialization. Predictive and mechanism evidence must be separated.

analysis_only_requests.inputs: Already preserved exact TRAIN target/cohort/context records
outputs: qA-qB total variation and JS with coverage
analysis_only_requests.interpretation: No/one-donor rows cannot steer; tiny target differences or nonreversible common targets qualify the contrast.

analysis_only_requests.inputs: Already preserved route preheads or donor predictions at selected states on the same exact eligible TRAIN rows
outputs: assignment-alignment T and its same-route-order common control
analysis_only_requests.interpretation: Assigned target fit is directly optimized and is not an independent measure of predictive utility. Entropy subtraction does not repair common target infeasibility.
analysis_only_requests.if_missing: Record absent evidence; do not silently execute additional forwards.

analysis_only_requests.inputs: Existing own-selected VALID predictions and original labels/metric protocol
outputs: split-common and split-base served metric/native proper loss
same-object repairs/harms and common-error counts where task-appropriate
link native rank/Hits/MRR changes with fixed negative protocol
oracle route upper bound separately labeled
analysis_only_requests.interpretation: Useful complementarity requires credible served gains and actual repairs; disagreement or oracle opportunity alone is insufficient.

analysis_only_requests.inputs: Existing captured native/auxiliary gradients only, or separately declared and charged later diagnostic work
outputs: auxiliary/native gradient norms by shared/private block
route-gradient agreement and source parameter support
analysis_only_requests.interpretation: Matching aggregate score cotangents do not guarantee matching shared gradients; finite/nonzero engineering gradients are not effect-size evidence.

analysis_only_requests.inputs: Existing frozen settings, convergence and actual cost records
outputs: context preprocessing and per-update pairwise cost
scope of any later independent confirmation
analysis_only_requests.interpretation: No additional-native-forward claim does not imply free cost. Existing bounded-pilot authorization applies; full-campaign GO remains separate.

outcome_interpretation.split_above_common_below_base: No useful benchmark improvement; easier/less harmful objective remains an explanation.
outcome_interpretation.served_gain_and_complementary_repairs: Evidence for utility in the tested protocol; not global novelty or out-of-distribution generalization.

prohibited_implicit_extensions: No restoring old fingerprint/panel study arms
No heldout-label target fitting or VALID-fitted combiner
No target/temperature/coefficient changes selected from current outcomes
No replacing frozen common arithmetic target mixing
